title: Fats Domino and the union fine
summary: Fined for refusing to play extra songs, he went to the union and was paid.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: What was he? He played more of swing. So did you, oh you also played with somebody we haven't talked about, you were in Fats Domino's band.

Yeah, for a while, yeah. I went to Europe with him. And before you went to Europe I played with the band and then something happened that made me quit, quitting the band. Well see what happened, we were supposed to play this club, I think it was in Canada. We were supposed to play this club and we were supposed to play a certain, a few hours, then take a break. So I forgot just how that thing happened, but I know when it was time for us to get off, they requested that we play a couple of more songs. So the guys in the band said, look, we're not going to play. So Fats Domino said, look, either you're going to play, I'm going to fine each one of you a hundred dollars. So I went back up there to play, and I was the only one on the bandstand. So after I found out I was the only one on the bandstand, and the other guys wasn't coming down, I left the bandstand. So he sent his road manager back there to tell him that all of us were fine, I mean fine a hundred dollars. I said, you don't mean me. He said, yeah, everybody who wasn't, I said I went on the bandstand, I wasn't going to stay on the bandstand by myself. So I left. So he fired me a hundred dollars. So I called the International Musician Union. And see a lot of the guys didn't know that a band leader cannot fire you. He reports you to the union, and the union could fire you.
Oh, so you'd have to go through the union to get fired? Yeah. Fined.

To find, yeah. So Fats Domino didn't know that. So the union made him pay me the money that he took out, plus gave me two weeks' pay for leaving. And then Fats told me, he said, look man, if you ever play to my band again, any time something goes wrong, don't turn me into the union. Fats scared of the union?
